rationale: Both sheets contain 2010-12-01..2010-12-09; rows are identical (22,523 = 22,523, all keys match). Keeping both double-counts these days. Sheet 2010-2011 copy is kept.

description: Drop exact duplicate rows (all 8 data columns), keep first
rationale: No invoice line number exists to distinguish genuine repeated lines from export duplicates; conservative choice is to treat identical rows as duplicates. Reported as a limitation.

description: Drop invoices with prefix A ('Adjust bad debt')
rationale: Accounting write-offs, not sales; 6 rows carry -147,614 GBP.
Zero-price lines are stock adjustments, damages and free items (mostly without Customer ID); they add no revenue but inflate Orders and Quantity Sold.

description: Drop accounting / fee / test StockCodes: ADJUST, ADJUST2, AMAZONFEE, B, BANK CHARGES, CRUK, D, M, S, TEST001, TEST002, m
rationale: Manual corrections, discounts, samples, bank charges, marketplace fees, commissions and test items are not product sales.

description: Drop postage / carriage StockCodes: C2, C3, DOT, POST
rationale: Target KPI is merchandise revenue; shipping charges are pass-through and not driven by the same process.

description: Drop orders with Quantity >= 50,000 together with their exact same-customer cancellation
rationale: Two entry errors (80,995 and 74,215 units) cancelled within minutes; they would create artificial gross-revenue spikes.

description: Keep cancellations (Invoice prefix C), flag is_cancellation
rationale: Revenue is defined as gross sales (non-cancelled lines) to avoid negative daily values; cancellations feed the Cancellation Rate KPI.

description: Keep rows with missing Customer ID
rationale: They are real sales (~14% of revenue). Used for Revenue, Orders, Quantity; excluded only from Active Customers and Revenue per Customer.

description: Exclude partial last day 2011-12-09 from the daily KPI table
rationale: Transactions stop at 12:50 while the median last sale of a day is ~17:00; a truncated day would be a biased target observation.
